definition: A module-to-return/raise dependency path containing at least one control edge; direct module return; same action with syntactically equal lexical guards and identical reaching definitions for guard inputs. These are structural may-evidence, never necessity or replacement proofs.
analysis: Structured branch traversal and scalar reaching definitions; assignment kills, branch joins union, branch-local environments isolated, surviving continuation retains early-exit control. Treat the deletion marker as original-region membership, not a business predicate.
scope: execute(x,flag,removed), primitive integer/boolean inputs, one exact deletion marker and fixed Rejected wrapper. No loop, arbitrary try, hidden expression control, input mutation, heap, implicit exception or external effect proof.
unknown_rule: Unsupported structure => unknown. Partial graph => positive syntactic evidence may remain true; absent evidence is null rather than false. effect_summary_complete and deletion_authorized always false.
data_use: Extract from frozen source and declared domains only; seal facts before joining old labels for reporting. Prior cases/results are already known: this is a development regression, not fresh validation.
score_use: Enrich old feature records with three tri-state fields. Do not feed null into Boolean calibrator or change old probabilities. No refit, no new risk threshold or deployment promotion.
checks: Semantic boundary unit tests plus one static pass over the 16 frozen challenge programs. Reuse archived exhaustive labels, do not regenerate or expand them.
stop: One bounded control extension and fixed regression. Leave other effect gaps unresolved and documented; no database or performance experiment.
